macro.global_bond_selloff: CRITICAL: Bloomberg reports global bond selloff sends yields to highest level since 2008. 10-year US Treasury yield at highest since January 2025 as higher oil stokes inflation worries. Rate-hike bets firm across global markets.
macro.fed_policy: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease — adds to hawkish tone after Warsh's Jackson Hole comments. 10-yr yield surge reflects firming hike expectations.
macro.iran_hormuz: ESCALATING: FT reports Saudi and South Korean oil tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz. US-Iran military exchange continues; Brent above $90/bbl; supply disruption fears intensify.
macro.oil_prices: Rising oil prices stoke inflation fears, driving the global bond selloff. Higher energy costs feeding through to yields from Japan to UK and beyond per MarketWatch.
macro.china_pmi: Aug manufacturing PMI 49.8% (+0.6pt MoM), large enterprises 50.6% (+1.1pt); high-tech/new momentum stays in expansion — economy showing marginal improvement
macro.china_policy: 7 departments issued consumption goods upgrade plan (target ~60T social retail by 2030); PICC added ~30B yuan A-shares in H1; supports market sentiment
macro.gold_silver: Gold/silver under pressure as dollar strengthens and global yields surge; safe-haven bid offset by rate-hike expectations
macro.ai_corporate: Apple enters John Ternus era as AI challenges and memory crunch intensify; OpenAI ad business at $1B annualized; DeepSeek AI-rout chatter in market
macro.september_watch: Sept historically weak season; US labor data + tech earnings due this week; investors on high alert amid bond rout + Middle East escalation
